claim: Vera makes the leap from a flat graph of remembered facts to a CAUSAL MODEL of a domain: from captured situation-facts (what Lamar actually said) plus the reality loop's competing hypotheses, build_model_from_graph constructs a small directed graph of nodes and typed, confidence-weighted causal links (manager_change -> strain -> poor_sleep -> low_energy). Every edge is GROUNDED in observed evidence and cites it — an edge with no stated world-edge and no reality hypothesis is NEVER emitted (an ungrounded domain yields an EMPTY model; co-occurrence corroborates but never invents). The model is retrievable: it persists to its own .anima/{name}.worldmodel.json store and round-trips by id, additively (a second model never overwrites the first). It can be read back as a multi-hop causal through-line, and it LEARNS — a resolved reality outcome strengthens a confirmed link / weakens a contradicted one with an append-only history. It is INTERNAL-ONLY: flagged internal_only, every human-readable line passes the no-diagnosis clean-gate, and the module is imported by NOTHING on the live reply path (a shadow model that never speaks 'your manager is causing your insomnia' at the user).
owner: anima/world_model.py (build_model_from_graph = fuse world_state causal edges + reality competing hypotheses + co-occurrence into a grounded causal model; causal_chains = the multi-hop through-line; explain_model/explain_body = the clean-gated internal render; update_model_with_outcome = strengthen/weaken from a resolved outcome, append-only history; compare_models = the auditable before/after diff; get_model/models/store_path = the own-store retrieval; build_synthetic_model = the canonical seeded build reused by the observatory). Substrate: anima/world_state.py (capture_relations -> stated causal edges), anima/reality.py (form/resolve -> competing hypotheses). NO server/route/mouth wire by design (LAW 2 internal-only).

killer_test.setup: Hermetic temp store (world_model.STORE + world_state/reality/meaning/memory_lirf/constitution/reliability redirected). From captured situation-facts ('work's stressful because of my new manager', 'the stress is affecting my sleep', sleep -> low energy) plus a seeded+resolved reality competition (manager_change leading, sleep_decline confirmed): (A) build_model_from_graph builds a non-empty causal model with the manager_change -> strain -> poor_sleep -> low/energy chain, flagged internal_only. (B) GROUNDED: every edge carries a world-edge or reality-hypothesis source AND concrete evidence; >=1 edge from a stated world-edge and >=1 from a reality hypothesis; NO edge rests on co-occurrence alone. (C) NEGATIVE: an ungrounded domain on a fresh, never-seeded creature (photosynthesis) yields ZERO edges/nodes, and an unrelated topic on the seeded creature still emits no ungrounded causation. (D) RETRIEVABLE: causal_chains yields a >=3-hop through-line from an upstream cause to a downstream consequence; the model round-trips by id through its own .worldmodel.json store; a second build is ADDED not overwritten. (E) LEARNS: a confirmed sleep_decline outcome STRENGTHENS strain->poor_sleep with an append-only history entry; a contradicted one WEAKENS it (floored, never annihilated); compare_models reports the strengthened link. (F) INTERNAL-ONLY: explain_model names it an INTERNAL model, every generated body line passes the no-diagnosis clean-gate, and anima.world_model is imported by NOTHING in server.py/route.py/mouth.py. Real .anima byte-unchanged. scripts/certify_world_model.py is the executable form; the module's own `python3 -m anima.world_model --selftest` is the broader unit proof.
